Method of Attack: Remote access tool (RAT) used for unauthorized access and control
Impacted Systems: Data center of a Central Asian country
Indicators of Compromise: Use of RATs with source code publicly released in 2007 (ZxShell) and mid-2008 (Gh0st RAT)
Certificates from Hangzhou Shunwang Technology and Shanghai Hintsoft used for signing
Randomized Gh0st RAT identifiers to obfuscate network traffic
